About Curve


Founded in 2004, Curve Dental’s goal is to deliver cloud-based software that makes it easy to manage a dental practice. Serving over 100,000 dental professionals across 6,000+ practice locations in the United States and Canada, the company is privately held, with offices in Alpharetta, GA; Provo, UT; Calgary, Alberta; and Aberdeen, Scotland.

From the start, Curve has been singularly focused on the dental industry and is committed to delivering the best all-in-one dental practice management and patient engagement software for practices of all sizes.

Expand AllCollapse All

### 2004

#### Foundation

Curve Dental is founded with a vision for what **[the cloud](https://www.curvedental.com/why-curve-rocks)** could do for dentistry.

### 2005 to 2008

#### Research + Development

After extensive research, studies and testing, we release a beta version for long-term testing.

### 2009

#### Official Launch

At the Waypoint Conference, Curve Dental officially introduced our software to the North American market.

### 2010

#### Recognition

Curve Dental is recognized as a “Best Business Idea” by Discovering Startups.

### 2011

#### Native Imaging

Curve Dental introduces direct to the cloud capture of digital images, a patented process and innovative breakthrough.

#### Technology Awards

Curve receives the “Best of Class” Technology Award from the Pride Institute and makes the list of the Fifty Greatest Game Changers in Dentistry by Dental Products Report.

### 2012

#### Recognition

Curve Dental receives its second “Best of Class” Technology Award from the Pride Institute for digital imaging.

### 2013

#### Mobility and Connectivity

Curve Dental introduces mobile access,

integrated payment processing

and automated appointment reminders.

Curve organizes the first Orange User Summit.

### 2014 to 2015

#### Critical Integrations

Curve Dental announces **[integrations](https://www.curvedental.com/partner-list)**with CareCredit, ePrescribe, VoiP and more.

### 2016 to 2017

#### Smart Forms

Curve launches **[Smart Forms](https://www.curvedental.com/online-dental-forms)**so patients can fill out forms electronically in the dental office or within the patient portal, simplifying the forms process for both dental staff and their patients.

#### Certifications

Curve receives ISO and FDA certifications, cementing our place as a leader in practice management software.

### 2018

#### Battery Ventures Invests in Curve Dental

With Battery’s support, Curve commits to further investment in creating the best experience for Curve users.

#### **Business Intelligence**

We add dashboards, custom reporting and more to create superior **[business intelligence](https://www.curvedental.com/business-intelligence)** opportunities for our customers.

### 2019

#### Enhanced Features

Curve introduces all-new **[perio charting](https://www.curvedental.com/perio-charting)** designed to make it easier to enter and update charts with an easy-to-use interface and keyboard shortcuts.

We enhance functionality for **[ePrescribe](https://www.curvedental.com/eprescribe)** to enable dental professionals to send prescriptions from any digital device including smartphones and tablets.

### 2020

#### Multi-Clinic Support

We add in the ability to track and report on data across clinics, for better support of our multi-clinic offices, and a multi-insurance BI system so group offices can analyze their data across all of their instances.

#### **Teledentistry**

Curve helps customers respond to the COVID-19 pandemic by integrating with [**TeleDentistry.com**](https://teledentistry.com/) to offer new platforms for care.

### 2021

#### Patient Engagement - Now in Curve SuperHero™

Curve unveils the revolutionary **[Curve GRO™ Patient Engagement](https://www.curvedental.com/dental-patient-engagement-software)** tools inside of Curve SuperHero™ for a truly all-in-one practice management solution.

#### **Easier Payments For Practices and Patients**

Curve partners with **[Global Payments Integrated](https://www.curvedental.com/partner-list)** to help dental practices easily collect payments and empower patients to pay in ways

that work for them.

### 2022

#### The Curve Movement Grows

The Curve movement now includes over 50,000 dental professionals across the United States

and Canada.

#### **Shortcuts to Save Time**

Curve releases charting shortcuts that allow users to perform charting 200-300% faster.

#### **Artificial Intelligence**

Our integration with **[Bola AI](https://www.curvedental.com/partner-list)** enables users to leverage the latest in artificial intelligence for voice-activated perio charting.

#### **Curve Commits to Excellence**

Curve leadership commits to reinvesting $60M into our SuperHero™ solution over

the next 3 years.

### 2023

#### The Curve Movement  Keeps Growing

The Curve movement now includes over 70,000 dental professionals across the United States and Canada.

#### **Artificial Intelligence**

More AI. Our integration with Pearl's AI enables users to increase treatment plan acceptance.

### 2024

#### Curve Mobile Launches

Curve redefines practice flexibility with a robust mobile app, **[Curve Mobile](https://www.curvedental.com/mobile)**—giving dental teams secure, on-the-go access to schedules, patient information, and communication tools.

#### **Streamlined Front Desk Workflow**

Curve introduces new tools that put the key patient and appointment details right at staff's fingertips, simplifying the day-to-day at the front desk and chairside.

### 2025

#### Curve Recognized as an   Industry Leader

Curve is featured in Frazier & Deeter’s _Powerful Trends Shaping the Dental Industry_ report, recognized for its all-in-one architecture, cloud-based security, and ability to create more efficient, scalable dental workflows.

#### **Smarter Ways to Work and Connect**

Curve expands its platform with [**Ask CurveAI**](https://www.curvedental.com/customer-service), providing instant, in-platform answers to software questions, and [**Curve Chat**](https://www.curvedental.com/dental-patient-engagement-software), giving dental teams a secure way to communicate and collaborate within Curve.

#### **Advancing our Vision for AI-Powered Dentistry**

Curve launches the **[Care+ AI Suite](https://www.curvedental.com/ai)**, bringing embedded AI capabilities together across clinical and administrative workflows. The launch marked a major step toward Curve’s vision for AI built directly into the practice management experience.

#### **Automating Insurance Verification**

Curve launches [**Eligibility+**](https://www.curvedental.com/eligibility-plus), bringing automated, code-level insurance verification directly into the Curve platform to dramatically reduce manual verification and give patients clearer benefit information before treatment.

#### **Creating a More Connected Payment Experience**

Curve launches [**Curve Pay**](https://www.curvedental.com/payments), bringing payment processing directly into Curve with automated reconciliation, next-day payouts, and more flexible ways for patients to pay.

### 2026

#### Transforming the Clinical  Experience with AI

Curve launches [Curve Care+](https://www.curvedental.com/curve-care), bringing voice-driven AI to clinical documentation, charting, and perio workflows—helping teams work faster and stay focused on patient care.

#### **Recognized as a Top Workplace**

Curve is named a 2026 USA TODAY Top Workplace, recognizing the culture, employee experience, and people behind our continued growth.

#### **Leading the Way in Cloud-Native Dentistry**

HealthStream Ventures recognizes Curve as a market leader in its [2026 Dental Technology Landscape Report](https://dentalindustrytrends.org/), highlighting its unified, cloud-native platform and ability to help practices scale efficiently.

#### **100,000+ Active User Milestone**

Celebrating more than 100,000 dental professionals using Curve across 6,000+ practice locations in the U.S. and Canada

#### **$200 Million R&D Investment**

We announced significant [investment in Curve's award-winning software solution](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/curve-dental-announces-200-million-rd-investment-302856409.html) & comprehensive ecosystem of native best-in-class capabilities.
